# Krillion Knowledge Base & Daily Answers (LLMs.txt)
> Project: Krillion Hub & Krillion Unlimited
> Website: https://www.krillion.click/
> Updated: 2026-10-10

## Overview & Two-Tier Verification Methodology
Krillion is a web-based reverse-trivia daily challenge.
Players receive 7 daily prompts with a 25-second countdown per prompt.
Unlike traditional trivia games that reward common popular answers, Krillion awards depth points based on obscurity (up to 100 per prompt, 700 max, representing a descent to 7,000 meters in the ocean trench).

### Two-Tier Evaluation Architecture:
1. Tier 1 (Fact-Check Validity): Is the answer an objectively recognized entity meeting the prompt criteria? (e.g. For "Borders Germany", all 9 bordering countries are valid; Liechtenstein is invalid).
2. Tier 2 (Predicted Rarity Index): Evaluated via heuristic rarity modeling (top-of-mind linguistic frequency vs. long-tail obscure cataloging). Note: Scores represent an algorithmic model, not proprietary real-time player telemetry.

## Scoring Tiers (Predicted Model)
- Plankton (4–10 pts): The most common, obvious answers (e.g., Los Angeles for California city).
- Too Clever (8–15 pts): Overthought answers where many trivia players collide trying to sound smart (e.g., Sacramento, Pasadena).
- Schooler (16–30 pts): Mid-tier answers.
- Rare (32–60 pts): Model-predicted low-frequency candidates based on long-tail catalog obscurity.
- Deep Cut (64–85 pts): High-tier obscure knowledge.
- One in a Krillion (100 pts): The rarest legitimate answer that hits maximum ocean depth.

## Today's Daily Dive Answers (October 10, 2026 - Game #46)
1. A city in California:
   - Rule: Must be an officially incorporated municipality in the State of California.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Ojai, Weed, Yreka, Dunsmuir, Point Arena
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Sacramento, Oakland, Pasadena, Berkeley, Fresno
2. A mammal starting with the letter 'B':
   - Rule: Must be a recognized living mammal species under class Mammalia with an established common English name starting with 'B'.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Binturong, Bilby, Babirusa, Bettong, Bharal
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Baboon, Buffalo, Bonobo, Blue Whale
3. A movie directed by Quentin Tarantino:
   - Rule: Must be an officially theatrically released feature film credited with Quentin Tarantino as director.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Death Proof
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Reservoir Dogs, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, The Hateful Eight
4. A country that borders Germany:
   - Rule: Must be one of the exactly 9 recognized sovereign nations sharing a terrestrial land border with Germany.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Luxembourg, Denmark
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Netherlands, The Netherlands, Austria
5. A pasta shape or variety:
   - Rule: Must be a recognized authentic Italian pasta shape cataloged in official culinary registries.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Campanelle, Culurgiones, Busiate, Trofie, Casoncelli
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Ravioli, Gnocchi, Orzo, Farfalle, Rigatoni
6. A Summer Olympic sport or discipline:
   - Rule: Must be an official sport or discipline recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) on the Summer Olympic Programme.
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): Modern Pentathlon, Canoe Slalom
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Archery, Fencing, Badminton, Table Tennis, Skateboarding
7. An official member of the British rock band Queen:
   - Rule: Must be one of the four permanent official core recording members of Queen (1971–present).
   - One in a Krillion (Predicted 100 pts): John Deacon
   - Too Clever Trap (Predicted 15 pts): Brian May
